text:
Seedance 2.0 Fast is about 60 credits cheaper for a 15 second generation! It's also MUCH faster to generate!

The prompt adherence definitely took a hit (I asked for some specific spell effects that didn't happen) but it got the core idea down well.

Still looks really pretty!

I think it's definitely worth it for simpler scenes and will come up with some basic ideas to test another time.

#DreaminaAI
#DreaminaCPP
@dreamina_ai
content: Use Seedance 2.0 Fast for simpler scenes when you want cheaper (~60 credits less for 15s) and much faster generations, but avoid it for prompts requiring strict adherence to specific details/effects.

translations.es: Utiliza Seedance 2.0 Fast para escenas más simples cuando desees generaciones más económicas (~60 créditos menos por 15s) y mucho más rápidas, pero evítalo para prompts que requieran una estricta adherencia a detalles/efectos específicos.
translations.fr: Utilisez Seedance 2.0 Fast pour des scènes plus simples lorsque vous souhaitez des générations moins coûteuses (~60 crédits de moins pour 15s) et beaucoup plus rapides, mais évitez-le pour les prompts nécessitant une adhérence stricte à des détails/effets spécifiques.
translations.ja: シンプルなシーンには、Seedance 2.0 Fastを使用すると、より安価（15秒で約60クレジット節約）で非常に高速な生成が可能です。ただし、特定の詳細や効果に厳密に従う必要があるプロンプトには使用を避けてください。
translations.ko: Seedance 2.0 Fast는 더 저렴하고 (~15초당 약 60 크레딧 절약) 훨씬 빠른 생성이 필요한 단순한 장면에 사용하세요. 그러나 특정 세부사항/효과에 엄격히 따르는 것이 필요한 prompt에는 사용을 피하세요.
translations.pt-BR: Use Seedance 2.0 Fast para cenas mais simples quando você quiser gerações mais baratas (~60 créditos a menos por 15s) e muito mais rápidas, mas evite usá-lo para prompts que exigem aderência estrita a detalhes/efeitos específicos.
translations.zh-CN: 使用 Seedance 2.0 Fast 适用于简单场景，当您希望以更低的成本（大约少 60 个积分用于 15 秒）和更快的生成速度时，但对于需要严格遵循特定细节/效果的 prompts，请避免使用。
